contract.task_clause:
How does the greenhouse effect work?
Option A: Ozone transmits visible light allowing it to heat the surface but then absorbs most of the infrared heat trapping the heat near the surface.
Option B: Greenhouse gases transmit visible light allowing it to heat the surface but then absorb infrared light from Earth trapping the heat near the surface.
Option C: Greenhouse gases absorb infrared light from the Sun which then heats the atmosphere and the surface.
Option D: Greenhouse gases absorb X-rays and ultraviolet light from the Sun which then heat the atmosphere and the surface.
